prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: ONE wide landscape HOME TOWN / ADVENTURER HUB background illustration for a children's learning fantasy RPG. This is an art proposal, not a replacement of the live game yet. Explicitly NON-PIXEL, using the user's OWN original drawings as style references.
Input reference roles: image1 forest comic53 2 gives freely sketched brown contours, broad brushy tree shapes and hand-hatched shadows; image2 wolf-chase comic53 gives grassy hills, earthy path, rough soft flat color; image3 resting under tree comic53 3 gives warm brown bark and loose expressive greenery; image4 ensemble flyer gives the cozy rounded children's-book shape vocabulary and warm color harmony. Use THESE original hand-drawn shapes and markmaking, not generic polished anime scenery or previous pixel art.
Scene: a welcoming small fantasy village serving as the adventurers' home base, late-morning clear daylight. Around a gently irregular circular packed-earth village square stand a FEW distinct cozy buildings: a two-story timber-and-cream-plaster INN at RIGHT with a muted terracotta roof and simple hanging bed pictogram sign; a compact BLACKSMITH at LEFT with slate-blue roof, a rough wooden awning and a visible simple anvil under it, small chimney; a modest LIBRARY/SCHOOL near the upper center-left with sage-green door, broad warm windows and a small wooden book pictogram sign; and an outdoor wooden QUEST NOTICE BOARD beside the path at RIGHT of center, carrying three blank cream paper sheets. A little stone well sits off-center near back of square, never blocking the foreground. A broad old tree frames far LEFT edge. Low wooden fences, a few orange/cream flowers, uneven grass tufts, soft green hills beyond rooftops. Buildings are simple chunky forms, slightly crooked warmly hand-drawn beams, not architecturally precise. Different silhouettes but same illustrator and village. No grand castle or excessive shops.
Composition: WIDE HORIZONTAL 16:9, lightly elevated eye-level establishing view into the square, enough perspective to see facades and ground but NOT steep top-down/isometric tile map. Village square occupies broad CENTER and LOWER MIDDLE, buildings gathered along back and sides. Preserve a large calm low-detail foreground for future character/UI placement. Key buildings readable as broad shapes at game-screen size, without many tiny windows/props. The composition should feel inviting and clearly readable, with open paths connecting hub destinations. Keep important rooftops fully inside canvas. This is scenery, do not draw interface controls or labels.
Style/medium: warm reddish/chocolate-brown pencil outlines with uneven pressure, relaxed occasional doubled contours, short diagonal hatched shading on wood/roof/tree, broad softly brushed flat color with modest colored-pencil/pastel grain and gentle color variation. Cozy muted cream, ocher, moss green, slate blue, warm brown and terracotta palette. Trees drawn as loose clumps with a few energetic hatching strokes, NO thousands of realistic leaves. Match user's originals beyond texture: rounded forms, simple readable objects, unpretentious playful hand-drawn shapes. No 3D render, glossy gacha concept-art finish, photoreal lighting, pixel grid, smooth vector linework, airbrushed cinematic rays or ornamental filigree.
Output: a complete opaque background image filling wide landscape canvas. NO people, player characters, animals, monsters, text, lettering, logos, title, watermark, border, interface, speech bubbles or snowy/Christmas decorations. Pictograms may be simple hand-drawn OBJECT silhouettes only. Notice papers contain no text. A village illustration alone.
status: Local home illustration proposal only; no live background replacement
